title: Repair gnome-keyring plaintext keyrings rejected by gnome-keyring 50
body: Fixes the data-loss mechanism reported in #5105. ## Problem gnome-keyring 50 writes textual secrets with `g_key_file_set_value()`, which does not escape newlines. Any secret containing a raw newline (JSON with embedded PEM blocks, pretty-printed tokens) produces a plaintext keyring file the daemon cannot parse again. On the next start it logs: ``` keyring was in an invalid or unrecognized format: ~/.local/share/keyrings/<name>.keyring ``` silently drops the collection, and creates a fresh empty default. Browsers lose Safe Storage, SSO tokens vanish, and users perceive a full password wipe.

title: Honour explicit expireTimeout for critical notifications (#12911)
body: Closes #12911. Per the FreeDesktop notification specification, an explicit non-zero `expireTimeout` should be honoured regardless of urgency.
